title: i18n inventory
description: docs/adr/0027: ICU MessageFormat's own shape - one message key (citing content-inventory's component_ref or glossary's TERM-<hash>, ADR-0027 point 2) mapping to {locale: translated_string} per observed locale (point 3). Entirely absent in v1 - no hreflang/URL-locale-segment detection instrumentation exists; this schema validates the shape build_i18n_inventory produces against synthetic fixtures only.

additionalProperties.description: {locale: translated_string} - a BCP 47 locale tag to the observed text in that locale.
